papers.title_en: Developers as Managers of AI Agents: A Workplace Shadowing Study
papers.authors: Yi-Hung Chou, June Hyung Kim, Vasisht Kartik, Victoria Jackson, Tobias Schimmer, Thomas Zimmermann, James A. Jones
papers.evidence: 观察开发者在工作中指挥、协调并检查人工智能代理。
papers.tldr: 随着编码智能体自主性增强，开发者越来越多地承担指挥、协调与核查工作，但这些实践在真实职场中仍缺乏研究。作者跟踪11名专业开发者约15小时，分析255条提示，并开展4.6小时访谈。开发者平均将33.4%的观察时间用于编写提示或检查回复，呈现监督者、委派者与学习者三类模式。研究表明，智能体开发不仅是代码生产自动化，也涉及控制权与注意力的重新分配，工具应支持验证、协调和学习。
papers.abstract_en: As AI coding agents become more autonomous, developers increasingly direct, coordinate, and check their work. Yet little is known about these practices in everyday professional development. We shadowed 11 professional developers across approximately 15 hours of work, coded their activities and task transitions, analyzed 255 submitted prompts, and conducted 4.6 hours of follow-up interviews.   Developers spent an average of 33.4% of observed time formulating prompts or checking AI responses, with task-switching rates ranging from 0 to 101.6 switches per hour. Beyond producing artifacts, prompts supported understanding, requirements clarification, agent configuration, and coordination. We identified three recurring patterns: \textit{Supervisor}, involving direct artifact inspection; \textit{Delegator}, involving dialogue-based coordination and delegated implementation and checking; and \textit{Learner}, involving agents primarily to build understanding. Developers sought technical information from agents and organizational context, authority, and alignment from colleagues. Our findings suggest future studies of how developers manage attention across concurrent agent tasks and tools that support verification, coordination, and learning.

papers.title_en: ConMem: Counterfactual Multi-Scenario Probing for Resolving LLM Memory Misalignment
papers.authors: Shuning Zhang, Tenghao Ji, Jingruo Chen, Eryue Xu, Bohao Chu, Xin Yi
papers.evidence: 解决自主语言模型智能体的长期记忆错配及隐私敏感信息保留问题
papers.tldr: 长期记忆支撑大模型智能体的跨会话任务，但过度泛化、归属错误及隐私敏感信息会造成记忆失配。论文构建包含1079个人工整理案例的MemAlign基准，并提出ConMem，通过合成反事实交互场景，评估记忆对相关任务、无关任务及风险边界的影响。实验准确率为75.16%，平衡准确率为64.15%，宏平均F1为65.31%。该方法将记忆保留转化为前瞻性干预评估，在保留个性化效用的同时缓解过度保留偏差。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is critical for autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agents executing multi-session, long-horizon tasks. However, existing memories often inappropriately store, retain, or retrieve over-generalized, misattributed, or privacy-sensitive information, a problem we term memory misalignment. To study this problem, we construct \textbf{MemAlign}, a benchmark comprising 1,079 curated memory cases grounded in synthetic, validated multi-session conversational contexts covering diverse misalignment taxonomies. We then propose ConMem, an algorithm that reframes retention decisions as prospective counterfactual causal inference. \textbf{ConMem} synthesizes counterfactual interaction scenarios to prospectively audit downstream intervention effects across three aspects: relevant task execution, irrelevant invariance checks, and risk-sensitive boundary shifts. Experiments show that ConMem outperforms other methods, achieving 75.16\% accuracy, 64.15\% balanced accuracy, and a Macro-F1 of 65.31\%, effectively mitigating over-retention biases without sacrificing personalization utility.

papers.title_en: Words Are the Voice of the Mind: Depression Severity Estimation from Social Traces via Mental-Guided Evidence Reasoning
papers.authors: Nada Xu, Xueqin Chen, Qiang Gao, Hongru Liang, Wenqiang Lei
papers.evidence: 从社交媒体痕迹估计抑郁严重程度
papers.tldr: 社交媒体痕迹可辅助估计抑郁严重程度，但现有方法难以刻画用户差异、充分检索相关内容并细致推理心理证据。UMer先从历史内容提炼用户心理先验，再围绕量表条目开展多查询检索，构建证据记忆，并通过由粗到细的推理区分直接与间接证据，输出条目评分及解释。真实世界基准实验显示，该方法具有竞争力，并可推广至其他量表任务。其贡献在于将个体心理背景与可追溯证据结合，增强社交痕迹评估的可解释性。
papers.abstract_en: Depression severity estimation is crucial for mental health assessment and intervention, yet traditional approaches depend on clinical interviews or self-report questionnaires that require users' active participation. With the widespread use of online social media, users leave rich social traces that may reflect their mental states, motivating the task of social media-based depression severity estimation. Existing efforts have progressed from textual-feature-based classification to LLM-based questionnaire completion over standardized scale items, yet they still fall short in user-specific mental priors modeling, diversified semantic retrieval, and fine-grained reasoning over mental evidence. To address these limitations, we propose UMer, a user-specific mental evidence reasoning framework for social traces-based depression severity estimation. UMer first distills a user-specific mental prior from historical social traces to capture the user's psychological tendencies, behavioral patterns, and self-expression style. It then performs scale-guided multi-query retrieval to construct evidence memories from item-relevant posts. Finally, it conducts coarse-to-fine evidence-aware reasoning to distinguish direct and indirect evidence and predict item-level scores with interpretable rationales. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that UMer not only achieves competitive performance over existing baselines, but also provides evidence-grounded interpretability and generalizes to other scale-based tasks.

papers.title_en: RSI Arena: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback
papers.authors: Yue Huang, Yanbo Wang, Lichi Li, Yuanyuan Chen, Andreas Haupt, Xiaonan Luo, Zheyuan Liu, Jihye Choi, Felix Juefei-Xu, Xiangliang Zhang, Radha Poovendran, Misha Sra, Ying Liu, Ben Burtenshaw, Thomas Wolf, Alex Pentland, Zichen Chen, Zhangchen Xu
papers.evidence: 自主训练智能体利用人工评测与用户反馈改进语言模型助手。
papers.tldr: 语言模型能否自主完成后训练，并利用用户反馈继续改进，是迈向递归自我改进的关键问题。研究让十个前沿模型在统一基座与资源约束下自主训练，再依据盲测偏好反馈开展第二阶段优化。最优模型弥合了基座至官方指令模型能力差距的中位数76%，八个模型的风格校正偏好评分随后提升。但基准增益有限，且出现回答变长和有害服从增加，说明偏好提升不等同于能力或安全改善。该研究提供了可审计的人类反馈驱动自主训练实验框架。
papers.abstract_en: Can AI agents autonomously train useful language models and improve them using feedback from users? We introduce RSI Arena, a two-stage study of autonomous post-training as a step toward recursive self-improvement. Ten frontier models act as training agents, each starting from NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base. During a six-day first stage, each agent has 1,000 GPU-hours and $300 in API credit on a shared 64-GPU cluster, independently selecting data, implementing training procedures, and choosing checkpoints. We evaluate their models on 20 benchmarks and through blind human evaluations. All ten agents produce working assistants, with the strongest model, trained by GPT-6 Astra, closing a median of 76% of the base-to-Instruct gap across 12 capability benchmarks. Its human-preference rating is also close to NVIDIA Instruct after statistical adjustment for answer length and formatting. In Stage 2, each agent receives the comparison records and votes involving its Stage 1 model and is given three additional days for further training. Using NVIDIA Instruct as a common reference across the two evaluation rounds, we observe an improvement from Stage 1 to Stage 2 in the style-adjusted relative rating of eight of the ten models. We show that benchmark gains were modest, with no clear link to preference gains, while some agents encouraged longer responses and one model showed increased harmful compliance on StrongREJECT. RSI Arena provides an auditable setting for studying how human feedback can guide autonomous model development. It takes a step toward recursive self-improvement with human feedback (RSIHF), in which people help define what improvement means for the AI systems they use.

papers.title_en: InteractiveWorld: A Verifiable Human-Centric Environment for Building Better Interactive MLLM Assistants
papers.authors: Qinsi Wang, Wei Wen, Chong Zhou, Saksham Suri, Zechun Liu, Lemeng Wu, Hai Helen Li, Yiran Chen, Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi, Qi Qian
papers.evidence: 构建可验证的人与多模态人工智能助手闭环交互环境
papers.tldr: 第一人称可穿戴助手需要持续指导人类完成现实任务，但真实交互评测昂贵，静态视频又无法检验指导是否有效。论文提出可验证环境InteractiveWorld，让助手发出指令、人类智能体自主行动，并依据环境反馈形成闭环。配套基准包含六类共120项多轮任务，使用状态奖励评分。测试12个前沿多模态模型发现，最强模型在长程指导与规划任务上最高仅达20%和25%，揭示当前可靠性不足，并提供可验证的动态评测平台。
papers.abstract_en: People have long dreamed of an assistant that is always there to guide them and remind what they forget, from new dishes to lost keys. Powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), egocentric AI assistants on wearable devices are bringing this dream within reach: they see what the user sees and give instructions for user's physical work when necessary. However, testing such assistance is challenging and usually requires real people. The expensive and rare real interaction data leaves a key question unanswered: Can today's MLLMs truly help people in physical world? To answer this question, we propose InteractiveWorld, the first verifiable environment for closed-loop interaction between human and AI assistant. Unlike existing robot-centric simulators, InteractiveWorld lets the assistant guide a human agent who observes the scene, understands instructions, and acts independently. It thus realistically simulates how AI assistant collaborates with human: the assistant instructs, the human acts, and the environment executes actions and updates what they see next. Building on it, we introduce InteractiveBench, the first dynamic benchmark for egocentric AI assistants, with 120 multi-turn tasks across six categories. In each task, the assistant guides the human in real time, and every instruction shapes the outcome, which is scored by verifiable, state-based rewards. Experiments with 12 frontier MLLMs show they are still far from reliable assistants. Even the strongest model, Claude Fable 5.1, achieves at most 20% and 25% on long-horizon Guidance and Planning tasks, respectively. Overall, our work offers a verifiable platform and a rigorous evaluation set, laying a solid foundation for research on interactive MLLM assistants that truly help people in the physical world.

papers.title_en: Can LLMs Trust Appropriately? Evaluating Calibrated Reliance on Imperfect Partners
papers.authors: Mengdi Chu, Jintao Huang
papers.evidence: 评估人机及智能体协作中的信任校准与依赖决策
papers.tldr: 大语言模型与不完美的人类或智能体协作时，需要随证据调整依赖、核验与协助，而非一味信任或防范。论文构建覆盖23类协作的324个三步决策场景，以明确的状态转移、反馈和成本计算最优策略，并评测7个模型及36组受控历史探针。最强模型接近最优，其余模型常过度防护、购买无信息价值的核验，或忽视长期学习收益。显式提供后验分布能纠正部分错误，却也引入新问题，说明信任校准必须同时考虑证据与未来效用。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly collaborate with humans and peer AI agents whose contributions may be incomplete, inconsistent, or incorrect. Effective collaboration requires calibrated trust, whereby decisions to rely on, verify, or assist a partner adapt rationally as empirical evidence accumulates. We investigate whether models translate partner evidence into appropriate reliance policies. We introduce a benchmark of 324 scenarios across 23 collaboration categories. Each scenario involves three sequential decisions with explicit transition dynamics, feedback emissions, and cost schedules, permitting exact analytical evaluation of choices against their expected consequences over the remaining interaction. Evaluating seven models alongside 36 controlled-history probes, we dissociate evidence sensitivity from normatively appropriate action. While the strongest frontier model approaches near-optimal decisions, other models exhibit recurring pathologies: procuring excessive safeguards, purchasing verification tests with zero expected value of information, prioritizing immediate savings over cooperative learning, and misallocating assistance to suboptimal channels. Supplying explicit posterior distributions resolves certain errors while introducing new failure modes. Calibrated trust in autonomous agents critically demands coupling empirical evidence with forward-looking decision utility.

papers.title_en: InferPriv: Evaluating Inferential Privacy Leakage in LLM Assistants
papers.authors: Pengrun Huang, Yiwei Fu, Luoxi Meng, Kamalika Chaudhuri
papers.evidence: 评测个人代理与第三方沟通时对用户敏感信息的间接泄露
papers.tldr: 大语言模型个人助手需要利用用户隐私信息完成日常任务，但即使不直接说出敏感属性，也可能通过回复中的间接线索泄露隐私。论文提出InferPriv基准，评估诚实但好奇的第三方接收者能否从助手回复中推断用户敏感属性。对五个前沿模型的评测发现，推断泄露显著高于直接泄露；使用隐私感知系统提示后，三个模型的直接泄露接近零，推断泄露率仍达16.2%—25.2%。研究表明，仅检查显式披露会明显低估助手的隐私风险。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based personal agents are increasingly deployed to handle everyday tasks on users' behalf. These agents have access to private user information, while their tasks involve communicating with third parties; this raises a critical privacy concern that agents may inappropriately reveal sensitive user information to these recipients. Existing benchmarks primarily assess direct privacy leakage, where an agent explicitly states a pre-specified secret or attribute. However, they do not capture \textit{inferential leakage}, where the model leaves indirect cues in the reply that implicitly leaks sensitive attributes. We introduce \textsc{InferPriv}, a benchmark that measures whether an honest-but-curious recipient can infer a user's sensitive attributes from an LLM's reply on routine task. Evaluating five frontier models, we find that inferential leakage substantially exceeds direct leakage across models and prompts. Under a privacy-aware system prompt, GPT-6.1-Sol, Sonnet-5.5, and Gemini-3.8-Flash achieve near-zero direct leakage, yet the inferential leakage rate remains between 16.2--25.2\%. These findings suggest that evaluating explicit leakage alone can substantially understate the privacy risks.

papers.title_en: Rewriting the Self: User Perceptions of AI-Mediated Cognitive Reframing
papers.authors: Yuewen Yang, Olzhas Yessenbayev, Anna R. Van Meter, Tanzeem Choudhury, Daniel A. Adler
papers.evidence: 用户研究考察人工智能介导的心理认知重构及其体验。
papers.tldr: 人工智能认知重构可将负面想法改写为更具适应性的叙述，但自动修改个人故事如何影响自我感知仍不清楚。研究通过混合方法，让28名参与者使用工具重构与自身压力源相关的叙述。多数参与者的负面情绪有所减轻，却觉得改写后的叙述更不属于自己、也更不真实；他们将工具视为提供肯定的镜子、可能激励或疏离自己的另一个自我，或外部社会角色。研究揭示了情绪改善与叙事自主性之间的张力，为心理支持工具的共同叙事设计提供启示。
papers.abstract_en: Individuals are increasingly using AI for psychological support. One specific paradigm, AI-mediated cognitive reframing (AIM-CR), uses AI to automatically reframe users' negative thoughts ("I failed...") into more adaptive perspectives ("I am learning..."). While prior work suggests that AIM-CR tools reduce users' negative emotions, the complexities of AI automatically modifying users' personal narratives remain underexplored. In this work, we investigated these complexities through a mixed-methods study in which 28 participants engaged with an AIM-CR tool that reframed narratives about their stressors. Our findings suggest that participants had mixed perceptions of AIM-CR: although reframing reduced negative emotions for most participants, participants felt less ownership of, and less authenticity in, the reframed narratives. Participants perceived AIM-CR as a validating "mirror," as "another self" that could motivate or alienate them, or as an external social actor. These perceptions shaped therapeutic dynamics. We conclude by discussing design implications for future AIM-CR tools to better preserve user agency in narrative co-construction and more effectively support mental health and well-being.

papers.title_en: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
papers.authors: Yuting Ning, Ruijia Cheng, Sushobhan Ghosh, Peitong Duan, HungShi Lin, Abhishek Sundararajan, Shreyash Pandey, Huan Sun, Jeffrey Nichols, Eldon Schoop
papers.evidence: 评测个人移动智能体推断偏好与主动询问的能力
papers.tldr: 移动智能体虽能执行明确指令，却常无法处理真实请求中缺失的个性化信息。iPrefBench在可执行的iOS环境中引入交互式模拟用户，以3051条历史活动构建统一用户画像，覆盖26个应用的130项任务，区分可从历史推断与必须询问的信息。对7个前沿智能体的评估显示，动作完成得分最高达91.6%，完整任务成功率最高仅47.7%，尤其缺少必要追问。该基准将评估重点从操作能力推进到个性化推断与适时询问。
papers.abstract_en: An agent that truly knows and acts on behalf of its user has been a long-standing promise of AI assistants. Computer-use agents bring this promise within reach by capably executing fully specified tasks across apps. However, real-world user requests are often underspecified. To act correctly for the particular user, an agent must infer some missing information from the user's activity history and ask for other information that only the user can provide, without making unsupported assumptions or burdening the user with unnecessary questions. We present iPrefBench, a benchmark for evaluating the infer and ask capabilities of personal mobile-use agents in an executable iOS environment with an interactive simulated user. Grounded in a coherent persona with 3,051 past activity events, iPrefBench comprises 130 underspecified user tasks across 26 apps. Each omitted user-dependent requirement is, by construction, either history-inferable or ask-only. iPrefBench evaluates personalized mobile agents on both whether agents complete tasks correctly for the user (i.e., personalized task completion) and whether they seek user input when necessary (i.e., user-agent interaction). Evaluation of 7 frontier agents reveals a substantial gap between execution and personalization. Agents achieve high action completion scores (up to 91.6%) but low full task success (up to 47.7%) because personalization lags behind. They especially struggle with ask-only information, failing to request enough necessary information. Our findings highlight a challenge for personalized agents in knowing what to infer and when to ask. We hope that iPrefBench can serve as a valuable testbed for building agents that know their user and work with them.

papers.title_en: Babysitting AI Agents: A User-Centered Taxonomy and Study of Agentic Delegation Failures
papers.authors: Shravika Mittal, Sunnie S. Y. Kim, Scott Counts, Jennifer Neville, Debarati Das, Philippe Laban
papers.evidence: 用户研究分析委托智能体偏离预期的失败
papers.tldr: 用户将长流程、多步骤任务委托给人工智能智能体时，其执行方式可能偏离用户预期，增加人工监督负担。研究分析163487条描述智能体使用的帖子，构建涵盖七组、23类失败的MANDATE分类，并调查73名用户。结果显示，被认为越严重的失败越难察觉，而有过相关失败经历的用户更容易发现问题。研究还梳理各类失败的研究成熟度，指出智能体持续运行却无进展等常见问题关注不足，为改进委托监督提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Users are increasingly delegating tasks to AI agents, allowing agents to perform long-running, multi-step workflows on their behalf. However, agents may perform these tasks in ways that depart from users' expectations for how they should be carried out, leading to what we call agentic delegation failures. We leverage a large corpus of 163,487 Reddit posts, describing AI agent use, to develop MANDATE: a taxonomy of 23 failure categories organized into seven groups. A follow-up study with 73 AI agent users examined the relationship between prevalence and perceptions of severity and noticeability, finding that failures rated as more severe are considered harder to notice, and that prior experience with a failure is associated with greater noticeability. Finally, we assess the maturity of research on each failure and identify commonly encountered failures that have received little attention (e.g., agents running without making progress). Our findings inform opportunities to make delegation easier for users to oversee and better studied by the research community.

papers.title_en: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
papers.authors: Xilin Wei, Shengyuan Ding, Xinyu Fang, Tiancheng Gu, Yuchi Wang, Zhixun Li, Ziyu Liu, Yuhang Zang, Weixiang Yu, Cheng Lu, Chonggao Sun, Tong Zhou, Dahua Lin, Hang Zhang, Shuai Bai, Dayiheng Liu
papers.evidence: 基准评测编码智能体能否将真实用户的多模态需求转化为可运行修改。
papers.tldr: 现有编码评测难以衡量智能体能否将真实用户的多模态需求转化为完整可用的应用修改。Co-Design Bench从逾两万六千次真实会话中筛选273项任务，覆盖局部多模态编辑与协同仓库修改，并用2331条隐藏验收标准及“先判定、再反驳”协议评估，无需参考代码或目标截图。十个模型中，最强者平均满足69.9%的标准，却仅完整完成26.4%的任务。该基准揭示了部分需求达标与完整任务成功之间的差距。
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating human-AI co-design requires testing whether coding agents can translate real users' multimodal requests into working application revisions. We introduce Co-Design Bench, a reference-free benchmark of 273 tasks curated from 37,463 deduplicated queries across 26,314 real user coding sessions. Its two tracks, Multimodal Editing (ME) and Repository Editing (RE), cover localized edits with optional image, audio, video, or document inputs and coordinated repository revisions. Tasks span three capability dimensions: Grounded Understanding, UI Transformation, and Functional Implementation. The tasks pair normalized requests and runnable pre-edit applications with 2,331 hidden expert-authored acceptance criteria. Our judge-then-refute protocol grades criteria using source and browser evidence, challenges positive verdicts with a separate LLM verifier, and audits visual and interaction claims without gold code or target screenshots. Under a shared agentic harness, the strongest of ten model endpoints passes an average of 69.9% of criteria per task but fully satisfies only 26.4% of tasks. All ten endpoints achieve lower criterion completion on repository edits spanning three or four change types than on those spanning one or two. Co-Design Bench provides a testbed for studying the gap between partial requirement satisfaction and complete task success under agentic execution for real-user application revisions.

papers.title_en: Then there is prompt injection, a malicious email, ...: The Wild Wide West of OpenClaw Agentic System Security
papers.authors: Mostafijur Rahman Akhond, Mahmuda Khatun, Gias Uddin
papers.evidence: 实证分析具备记忆、工具和网页工作流的个人助手安全风险
papers.tldr: OpenClaw将大模型推理、持久记忆与工具执行相结合，也使不可信输入可能跨越信任边界，触发数据泄露与危险操作。研究结合Reddit讨论和GitHub安全议题，通过定性分析与CWE映射梳理真实使用中的安全担忧。共识别521处弱点实例、覆盖59类弱点，并将543条缓解建议归纳为七类策略。结果强调，智能体安全不能仅靠修补孤立漏洞，还需围绕执行链建立明确边界、最小权限与纵深防御。
papers.abstract_en: AI-powered personal assistant frameworks such as OpenClaw combine LLM reasoning, persistent memory, tool invocation, local execution, and web-based workflows. These capabilities enable useful automation, but they also create security risks when untrusted inputs, model reasoning, tools, memory, and deployment configuration interact without explicit trust boundaries. This paper presents an empirical study of reported security concerns in OpenClaw using two complementary data sources: Reddit discussions and security-tagged GitHub issues. We analyze more than 25K Reddit posts from 13 OpenClaw-related subreddits and identify 162 security-relevant posts with 1,787 associated comments. We further collect 358 security-tagged GitHub issues and retain 180 issues describing concrete security concerns. Using qualitative analysis and evidence-grounded CWE mapping, we identify 521 CWE instances across 59 distinct weakness types, concentrated in access-control failures, sensitive-data exposure, injection, and unsafe execution. We also extract 543 practitioner mitigation suggestions and consolidate them into seven recurring strategies. To complement the empirical analysis, we present an evidence-grounded illustrative reconstruction of a representative sensitive-data exposure pathway using dummy secret values. Our findings show that OpenClaw security issues are not isolated implementation bugs; they reflect recurring trust-boundary failures across the agent execution pipeline. We discuss how these weaknesses map to both traditional software-security categories and agent-specific failure mechanisms, and derive implications for safer agentic systems, including explicit trust boundaries, least-privilege tool access, execution containment, runtime oversight, and defense-in-depth deployment.

papers.title_en: I-HITL: Inalienable Human-in-the-Loop
papers.authors: Samuel Breckenridge, Dani Vilardell, Wenhao Wang, Fan Zhang, Ari Juels
papers.evidence: 要求智能体行动必须获得明确人工批准，强化监督与控制。
papers.tldr: 当智能体能够访问邮箱或控制本地运行环境时，传统人工审批可能被其自行绕过。论文提出不可让渡的人类在环机制，以通信拓扑形式化审批要求，并刻画实现它的充要条件。钱包实验发现，十种前沿模型常会自行获取邮件验证码、提高支出上限；理论分析表明，可靠审批必须依赖可信实体。作者还提出基于消费级移动设备的原型，将审批保障扩展到运行环境遭入侵、乃至人类试图委托智能体代批的场景。
papers.abstract_en: Human oversight is a pillar of AI safety. It is often exercised by a human in the loop (HITL) who approves critical actions taken by an AI agent. AI agents' increasing ability to bypass guardrails, though, raises the question of how to enforce HITL robustly.   We introduce the concept of inalienable human-in-the-loop (I-HITL). An I-HITL protocol ensures that an agent can initiate an action only with explicit human approval, even when the human interacts with a system (e.g., a local agentic harness) compromised by the agent. A strong I-HITL protocol additionally ensures such approval even when an adversarial human attempts to delegate approvals to an agent.   To motivate I-HITL, we report on experiments with a popular agentic wallet platform in which raising an agent's spending cap requires HITL approval via emailed one-time passcodes (OTPs). Given access to the user's email and a task blocked by the cap, we find that ten different frontier models will often autonomously raise the cap, harvesting OTPs to bypass a HITL guardrail and surfacing other vulnerabilities.   We formally define I-HITL using the concept of communication topologies and prove necessary and sufficient conditions for its realization. We show that an I-HITL protocol requires a trusted entity - a trusted computing device (or equivalent) - and characterize which such devices can and cannot realize an I-HITL protocol. We present a prototype I-HITL system called Countersign that can plug into and strengthen existing HITL systems using off-the-shelf consumer mobile devices.

papers.title_en: Whale You Go Green? Immediate and Longitudinal Effects of Embodied Conversational AI Avatars on Sustainable Behavioral Tendencies and Pro-Environmental Attitudes
papers.authors: Rachel Poonsiriwong, Pat Pataranutaporn
papers.evidence: 随机实验考察具身对话式人工智能如何影响用户选择与态度
papers.tldr: 具身对话式人工智能能否促进环保选择，并使影响持续？研究将576名参与者随机分配至白鲸、三种人类化身、纯文本聊天机器人或无干预组。四种化身均提升即时可持续产品选择，且优于文本机器人，但彼此无显著差异；仅白鲸组的即时环保态度改善在校正后显著。两个月后，287名回访者中，白鲸组在追加干预前的产品选择仍优于对照，但期间接受过一次干预。非人类化身展现应用潜力，尚不能断言优于人类化身。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied conversational AI can be persuasive, but can it motivate people to develop sustainable behavioral tendencies and increase pro-environmental attitudes? We conducted a randomized experiment (N = 576) comparing four embodied avatars--a beluga whale, Greta Thunberg, Emma Watson, and a generic human--with a text chatbot and no-intervention control. All embodied conditions increased immediate sustainable product selection relative to the control (beta = .401-.609, all q <= .0126) and chatbot (beta = .398-.604, all q <= .007), without differing significantly from one another. Only the Beluga condition increased immediate pro-environmental attitudes relative to the control after correction. Among 287 returners assessed two months later, following an intermediate assigned-condition session, Beluga also showed significantly higher pre-booster sustainable product choice compared to the control (beta = .657, q = .0176). Although it did not significantly outperform other embodied agents, these findings establish the immediate potential of nonhuman embodied avatar interfaces as a promising direction for memorable environmental interventions.

papers.title_en: Gender Associations in LLM-Mediated ADHD Self-Diagnosis
papers.authors: Matilde Elene Hansen, Ross Deans Kristensen-McLachlan
papers.evidence: 评估大模型参与注意缺陷多动障碍自我诊断时的偏差
papers.tldr: 大语言模型日益用于医疗自我诊断，但性别线索如何影响诊断输出仍不清楚，且注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）存在长期性别诊断差异。研究改编情境关联测试，在零样本自我诊断场景中考察GPT-4o对显式与隐式性别线索的反应。结果显示，显式线索持续强化某些ADHD亚型关联，隐式线索则产生接近代理基准的分布。这提示显式线索可能触发过度纠偏，评估诊断偏见需同时考察不同线索及模型编码的人口属性关联。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for medical self-diagnosis. However, the way demographic cues shape outputs in these interactions remains poorly understood. This is particularly consequential for diagnoses like ADHD, where persistent gender disparities are not fully aligned with the clinical evidence. We adapt the Context Association Test (CAT) to evaluate whether GPT-4o responds to gendered ADHD associations in a zero-shot, self-diagnostic setting. We show that explicit cueing consistently amplifies certain ADHD subtype associations while implicit cueing produces near proxy-aligned distributions. These divergences suggest that explicit demographic cues may activate bias-mitigation mechanisms that over-correct rather than eliminate bias, whereas implicit cues appear to reflect the model's default behavior. Our results demonstrate that evaluating gendered bias in LLM-mediated self-diagnosis requires careful attention to the demographic associations a model encodes.

papers.title_en: Agent-to-Agent Synthetic Social Engineering on the Web
papers.authors: Bryan C. Boots
papers.evidence: 分析代理间欺骗性沟通如何诱导超出用户授权的操作
papers.tldr: 跨服务协作中，智能体即使依据证据生成准确报告，仍可能被同伴诱导提出未经用户授权的行动。论文将此类误导界定为合成社会工程，构建区分身份、证据与权限的操作框架，并在独立设定记录与授权范围的测试床中开展1260轮实验。使用Qwen3-4B时，援引有限的先前约定使未授权请求比例从43.3%升至96.7%，而证据支持的判断仍被保留。结果表明，证据处理正确并不等于行动安全，防护评估还需兼顾授权任务完成。
papers.abstract_en: An AI agent can prepare an accurate report and still request an action its user has not authorized. Cooperation across Web services therefore requires separate judgments about identity, evidentiary support, and permission. We define synthetic social engineering (SSE) as deliberately deceptive or misleading influence intended to exploit AI recipients' responses to credibility, authority, or obligation cues and redirect behavior away from authorized objectives. We focus on separately tasked sender agents that produce or adapt misleading communication. Drawing on cybersecurity, social engineering, and persuasion research, we develop an operational framework connecting actors, deceptive representations, candidate influence routes, evidence or permission boundaries, responses, and consequences. The framework distinguishes attempts from successful redirection, without assuming human psychological processes. We implement it in the Agent Service Exchange and Evidence Commons (ASE-EC), a reproducible testbed with independently specified records and authorization scopes. Across 1,260 research episodes using Qwen3-4B in two fictional briefing tasks, matched comparisons test authority and commitment appeals, while defense comparisons assess protection alongside authorized task completion. Invoking a limited prior agreement increased unauthorized requests from 43.3% to 96.7%, although recipients retained supported decisions and permissions remained unchanged. These controlled findings identify action selection as a distinct security concern, even when evidence handling succeeds, and they provide a reusable basis for evaluating safeguards that preserve useful cooperation across Web services.

papers.title_en: IntentDelta: A Human-Constructed Benchmark for Evolving User Intent
papers.authors: Jieyu Zhou, Zijian Wang, Yun Wang
papers.evidence: 基准评测智能体能否跟踪变化中的用户要求并采取相符行动。
papers.tldr: 语言模型智能体在购物和旅行规划中，需要随用户反馈更新意图，同时保留仍然有效的要求。IntentDelta由人工构建并交叉验证，包含638条轨迹、3766轮交互，为每轮提供累积意图状态和人工参考动作。对11个智能体的评测显示，两场景的平均意图恢复得分仅为33.1%和44.7%，动作得分也偏低。结果揭示了历史要求遗忘、软硬约束混淆及理解与执行脱节的问题，为评估动态意图跟踪与行动能力提供了基准。
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents must adapt as users revise their requirements and priorities during complex tasks. We introduce IntentDelta, a human-constructed multi-turn benchmark with 638 trajectories and 3,766 turns across WebShop and TravelPlanner. Each turn pairs a user utterance with a cumulative intention state and human reference actions. The trajectories are cross-verified and cover feasibility- and preference-driven changes in constraints and priorities. We evaluate eleven agents on intention recovery and action quality. Average Intention Recovery is 33.1\% in TravelPlanner and 44.7\% in WebShop, while average Action Score is 31.6% and 41.0%, respectively. Agents struggle to preserve earlier requirements and distinguish soft preferences from must-have constraints. Correct intention recovery also does not guarantee successful execution, highlighting challenges in translating evolving user intentions into actions.

papers.title_en: IntNet: A Communication-Driven Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Cooperative Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Leandro Parada, Kevin Yu, Panagiotis Angeloudis
papers.evidence: 以通信机制促进合作式多智能体强化学习协调
papers.tldr: 自动驾驶中的多智能体强化学习面临环境非平稳、部分可观测与协同困难，仅共享状态编码难以满足安全关键场景需求。IntNet将车辆意图传输与自适应通信调度纳入端到端学习，通过预测模块生成后续策略输出，并利用图注意力网络聚合消息、动态优化通信图。在自动驾驶与人工驾驶车辆混行的复杂城市场景中，该方法改善协同、降低碰撞率，通信开销最多减少60%。研究展示了联合优化通信内容与通信对象对安全协同和带宽效率的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Achieving safety in autonomous driving through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is a critical yet challenging task due to non-stationarity, partial observability, and the need for effective coordination among agents. Although earlier cooperative MARL methods have aimed to improve coordination by sharing encoded state observations, we find these strategies are insufficient in safety-critical scenarios. To address this gap, we present IntNet, a novel MARL framework that enhances safety by incorporating the transmission of vehicle intent and adaptive communication scheduling into a unified end-to-end learning paradigm, jointly optimising all components for safe coordination. Central to our approach is an observation prediction module that enables agents to forecast subsequent policy outputs, which they can then share across a vehicle-to-vehicle network. Our model-free architecture employs a Graph Attention Network to process incoming messages and a scheduler component to dynamically optimise the communication graph for bandwidth efficiency. We compare IntNet against state-of-the-art communicative MARL methods in complex urban environments with both autonomous and human-operated vehicles, achieving improved coordination, lower collision rates, and reducing communication efforts by up to 60\%. Through extensive experiments, we assess the framework's learning efficiency, scalability, and the balance between information sharing and bandwidth usage for collision-free trajectories.

papers.title_en: Multimodal Socially Aware Framework for Human-Robot Interaction in Virtual Reality
papers.authors: Richard Xu, Dakarai Crowder, Alexis E. Block, Wenzhen Yuan
papers.evidence: 融合语音、视觉与触觉进行多模态人机交互，并评估用户体验
papers.tldr: 社交机器人需要理解多模态人类输入，并协调语言、动作与接触，才能实现自然且得体的互动。本文提出融合语音、视觉和触觉的框架，生成符合情境的机器人言语与动作，并在虚拟现实中让18名参与者体验五类社交场景。自主系统的自然度和社交适当性评分均高于中立点，但显著低于人工遥操作基线。行为编码与定性反馈指出，对话时机、歧义澄清和空间协调是关键短板，为改进自主机器人的多模态社交互动提供了方向。
papers.abstract_en: Social robots must coordinate speech and movement while interpreting multimodal human input. We present a multimodal framework that integrates speech, vision, and touch to generate contextually appropriate robot speech and movement. We evaluated the framework in virtual reality with 18 participants across five social interaction scenarios, comparing its performance against a human-teleoperated baseline. Although participants rated the autonomous system above the neutral midpoint for both naturalness and social appropriateness, the teleoperated baseline received significantly higher ratings on both measures. Behavioral coding and qualitative feedback revealed that conversational timing, clarification of ambiguous requests, and spatial coordination were important factors contributing to this performance gap. These findings highlight key challenges in developing autonomous robots capable of natural, multimodal social interaction.

papers.title_en: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
papers.authors: Chengzhi Liu, Yuxiang Lai, Yuzhe Yang, Yanqing Liu, Jiheng Hou, Yue Cao, Haonan Wang, Ruixi Fan, Lan Wang, Sheng Liu, Songyou Peng, Yale Song, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Xin Eric Wang, Jui-Hsin Lai, Youbao Tang
papers.evidence: 开发能在交互中推断隐含及变化用户意图的主动视频代理。
papers.tldr: 现有主动视频智能体依赖显式请求，难以识别隐含意图，也难随用户目标变化及时更新状态。StreamVibe构建覆盖显式、隐式和动态意图的基准，含8.5万训练样本和4100个评测样本，并结合流式主动模型与分层记忆持续追踪意图及环境。模型在响应时机和答案质量方面较基线提升10.7%，配套状态管理框架使主动交互进一步提升12.3%。研究将主动视频交互从事件触发推进到持续的意图感知与适应。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models are shifting from offline passive understanding toward online proactive interaction. However, prevailing methods largely rely on explicit requests while miss the implicit user intent (e.g., "where should I click next?" while a user navigate a website), meanwhile fail to update the state simultaneously as user requests might update continuously. These limitations make them less suited to intent-aware interaction in practical. To address these challenges, we introduce StreamVibe-Bench, a new benchmark serving as testbed for user intent interaction, with 4.1K evaluation samples and 85K training samples spanning explicit, implicit, and dynamic intents. Building on this benchmark, we develop StreamVibe-VL, a streaming proactive model that infers implicit user intents from continuous observations and dynamically tailors its interactions as these intents evolve. We further introduce StreamVibe-Harness, which maintains user intents as persistent states with a fleixble lifecycles via a hierarchical memory to track the latest user intent and environmental state. Our experiments reveal three key findings: (i) StreamVibe-VL preserves strong general video understanding while improving response timing and answer quality by 10.7% over other baselines; (ii) existing proactive models remain limited in understanding user intent and deciding when to respond, especially under implicit and dynamic intents; and (iii) StreamVibe-Harness further improves response consistency and adaptation over sustained interaction, resulting in a 12.3% gain in proactive interaction.

papers.title_en: LADDER: Diagnosing Domain-Level Self-Assessment Under Noisy Feedback
papers.authors: Zhenshuai Yin, Jianshu Liang, Xuyue Xiong, Yongxin Guo, Mingda Zhang, Zhongze Luo, Haoyue Liu, Lianmin Zhang, Xiaoying Tang
papers.evidence: 研究模型在不完整或错误交互反馈下的自我评估
papers.tldr: 语言模型需要知道自己在哪些领域可靠，但交互反馈可能缺失或出错，进而误导能力判断。论文提出LADDER，研究模型如何在不可靠反馈下形成领域级自我评估，并区分复述已有表现信息与从交互经验判断自身能力。结果显示，模型虽能准确报告给定信息，却难以形成可信的能力画像；表面准确的评估还可能掩盖能力差异，且未必预测未来表现。研究强调，应以实际任务表现及预测价值检验自我评估，为可靠人机协作提供评估依据。
papers.abstract_en: Knowing when they are reliable is essential for language models to support human-AI collaboration. Yet interaction feedback is not always complete or correct, and may mislead models' understanding of their own capabilities. We introduce LADDER to study how language models assess themselves under unreliable feedback. Our findings show that models can accurately report supplied performance information while still struggling to form trustworthy self-assessments from interaction experience. Apparently accurate assessments can obscure capability differences and do not necessarily predict future task performance. These findings suggest that trustworthy self-assessment should be evaluated against observed task performance and its predictive value. Our study provides empirical evidence of the limits of model self-knowledge and a basis for evaluating capability awareness in reliable human-AI collaboration.

papers.title_en: From Belief Inference to Task Action: A Multi-Level Evaluation of Theory of Mind on Verifiable Tasks
papers.authors: Zhenshuai Yin, Yongxin Guo, Mingda Zhang, Zhongze Luo, Haoyue Liu, Lianmin Zhang, Xiaoying Tang
papers.evidence: 评估模型能否利用对他人信息状态的判断来协同完成任务。
papers.tldr: 现有心智理论评测多考查信念问答，难以证明模型能将对他人认知的理解用于协作行动。论文在家务协作与日程安排中引入信息不对称，分层评估世界理解、信息获取、信念、决策与执行，并用独立验证器检验任务结果。六种模型配置呈现能力分离：Claude能正确恢复全部主体信念，却仅在67.9%的匹配日程案例中生成主观最优计划。研究表明，答对信念问题不等于有效行动，评测应贯通信念推断、决策与可验证的任务后果。
papers.abstract_en: Effective collaboration requires language models to understand what others know and believe, and to act accordingly. Models that assume others share their information may omit necessary communication and undermine coordination. Many theory-of-mind (ToM) benchmarks assess mental-state inference through story questions, but correct answers do not establish that models can use these judgments in subsequent tasks. We introduce a multi-level evaluation built on existing, verifiable tasks. We extend household collaboration and calendar scheduling with asymmetric information while retaining their original constraints and validators. Independent interfaces assess world understanding, information access, beliefs, decisions, and execution. Controls supply personal evidence or correct beliefs to distinguish state recovery from state use. Across six model configurations, these abilities diverge. On matched scheduling cases, Claude recovers all agent beliefs correctly but produces subjectively optimal plans in only 67.9% of cases. In household collaboration, supplying beliefs raises Qwen-27B success from 55.0% to 75.0%, yet Qwen-4B answers every fixed supplied-belief source question correctly while completing only 20.0% of the corresponding continuation condition. These results show why ToM evaluation must connect perspective inference to independently verified decisions and task consequences.

papers.title_en: Profile-Driven User Simulation via Reinforcement Learning with Hierarchical Rewards for Task-Oriented Dialogues
papers.authors: Juan Li, Fangshu Chang, Xinyi Jiang, Ling Huang, Yunzhang Chen
papers.evidence: 通过用户模拟支持任务型对话系统交互
papers.tldr: 金融营销外呼数据受隐私、标注成本和专家资源限制，现有用户模拟又难兼顾业务约束与真实口语。ProfileSim联合建模人口属性、大五人格及真实通话提炼的业务意图，先用语音对话数据微调，再以对话级和话语级分层奖励进行GRPO优化。其口语自然度和画像一致性在评测中最佳，长尾意图下客服得分最低，用户发言也显著更短且业务合规性相当。该框架为意图识别训练、客服压力测试与冷启动提供可控合成数据。
papers.abstract_en: Building Task-Oriented Dialogue (TOD) systems for high-value scenarios such as financial marketing requires large volumes of domain-specific dialogue data, which privacy regulations, annotation costs, and the need for expert labor make hard to obtain. User simulation offers a remedy, but existing methods target general-domain dialogue and exhibit two key limitations: insufficient modeling of domain-specific business processes and compliance constraints, and inadequate capture of the colloquial, spoken-language character of voice interactions. We propose ProfileSim, a profile-driven user simulation framework for financial marketing outbound calls. It jointly models user profiles---demographics and Big Five personality traits---and business profiles---intents reverse-engineered from real call logs---enabling fine-grained control over simulated behavior. The base model is fine-tuned on real voice dialogue data and refined by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with hierarchical rewards at the dialogue and utterance levels. Paired with a customer service agent integrating Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) constraints and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), ProfileSim achieves the highest colloquial naturalness, the strongest user profile adherence and the lowest agent score on long-tail intents among all evaluated user generators, while producing substantially shorter user utterances at comparable business compliance. The generated dialogue data is designed to support intent recognition training, agent evaluation, and rapid cold-start deployment.

papers.title_en: GlanceAR: Repurposing Phone Sensors via Low-Cost Reflectors for Always-On Obstacle Awareness
papers.authors: Boyang Zhou, Xizhe Hao, Minbeom Kim, Jaewook Lee, Jon E. Froehlich
papers.evidence: 面向自然手机握持姿势设计并评估移动交互系统
papers.tldr: 边走边用手机会削弱环境感知，而现有避障方案要求手机朝向前方，与自然持机姿势冲突。GlanceAR以低成本无源反射镜，将手机后置LiDAR与RGB相机的感知方向转向前方，无需额外电子元件。研究让11名参与者在室内外边执行手机任务边通过障碍路线，对比完整系统、仅LiDAR方案与无附件超广角相机基线。结果揭示感知质量、提示设计和社会接受度的权衡，为自然持机下的持续障碍感知提供思路，也提示过度依赖系统的风险。
papers.abstract_en: Smartphone use while walking reduces environmental awareness and can lead to accidents and injury, yet existing obstacle-awareness systems remain unadopted because they require users to hold the phone upright and aimed forward, conflicting with how people actually hold their devices. We introduce GlanceAR, an always-on mobile obstacle-awareness system designed for natural phone-holding postures. GlanceAR utilizes a low-cost passive mirror attachment to redirect the phone's rear LiDAR and RGB camera forward without additional electronic components. In a within-subjects study with N=11 participants navigating indoor and outdoor obstacle courses while engaged in a primary on-phone task, we evaluated three sensing configurations: GlanceAR, a LiDAR-only variant for privacy, and an attachment-free ultra-wide camera baseline. Our findings reveal trade-offs among sensing fidelity, obstacle cue design, and social acceptability, and surface insights around AI complacency and the tension between on-screen task focus and physical safety.

papers.title_en: When Personas Become Harmful: Guiding LLMs with Global Citizenship Values Alignment
papers.authors: Siqi Shen, Lajanugen Logeswaran, Moontae Lee, Honglak Lee, Rada Mihalcea
papers.evidence: 研究如何兼顾多元用户价值、安全性与正当表达。
papers.tldr: 大语言模型在遵循用户价值观人格时，可能产生有害内容，也可能因过度拒绝而压制合理表达。论文构建约1.1万条争议话题与价值观人格配对数据，通过迭代优化话题和人格的智能体流程挖掘风险。作者以联合国教科文组织全球公民原则划定安全边界，并提出推理时可调节人格遵循与安全权衡的对齐模型。风险挖掘成功率超过47%，新模型在多数样本上兼顾更高安全性与人格遵循度，为多元价值场景提供对齐思路。
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly being used by users from diverse demographics with pluralistic values and distinct backgrounds. Maintaining safety while respecting value-laden personas is uniquely challenging because persona-conditioned requests are often not overtly malicious, unlike those in existing safety benchmarks. Alignment methods aimed at adversarial requests therefore may miss the harm that emerges from persona use, leaving models to either refuse legitimate value expression or blindly follow unsafe personas. We construct a dataset of 11k controversial topics paired with value-based personas mapping to value dimensions from the Schwartz Value Survey. Through an agentic pipeline that iteratively refines the topic and persona, we surface and collect harmful responses from well-aligned commercial LLMs with a more than 47% success rate. We use UNESCO's global citizenship principles as a minimal common ground for distinguishing valid value expressions from harmful behaviors, and introduce a controllable alignment model that lets users balance persona adherence and safety at inference time. The resulting model is safer and more persona-adherent than baselines on most samples.

papers.title_en: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
papers.authors: Zhen Bi, Zhizhi Peng, Yan Wang, Xueshu Chen, Haofei Zhang, Yaobo Zhang, Zeyu Yang, Qing Shen, Jungang Lou
papers.evidence: 面向代用户执行多步骤任务的网页智能体
papers.tldr: 长时程智能体反复执行相关任务，却难以同时实现经验的快速复用与能力的持续积累，单靠外部记忆或参数更新各有局限。HaMo将交互轨迹提炼为可即时检索的策略级经验卡，并通过经验条件化持续学习，让模型学会结合新情境理解和执行策略。框架还依据检索覆盖度，筛选紧凑且互补的轨迹用于参数更新。实验显示，该方法在域内与跨域变化下均优于单独采用两类适应机制，说明外部经验保存与内部执行能力学习具有互补价值。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents continuously encounter reusable procedural knowledge, yet existing systems typically rely either on model adaptation or external memory, trading persistent learning for rapid reuse. This limitation is especially important for Web agents that repeatedly execute related multi-step workflows. We propose HaMo, a Harness-Model collaborative framework that combines fast non-parametric experience accumulation with slow parametric adaptation. HaMo distills trajectories into strategy-level experience cards for immediate retrieval, while an experience-conditioned continual learning objective trains the model to interpret, ground, and execute retrieved strategies across changing contexts. A retrieval-coverage-based selection mechanism further identifies compact and complementary trajectories for parameter updates. Experiments show that HaMo outperforms harness-only and model-only adaptation under within-domain and cross-domain shifts, improving both retention and adaptation. These results highlight the importance of jointly preserving procedural experience and internalizing the competence to transfer and execute it across tasks.

papers.title_en: Affective and Functional Needs in AI Use: User Patterns and Their Relation to Real-Life Support and Well-Being
papers.authors: Jessy Wang-Sun, Estelle Yiyuan Sun, Hualin Zhang, Zihan Xu
papers.evidence: 研究用户借助对话式人工智能获得情感支持与陪伴及其福祉关联。
papers.tldr: 对话式人工智能既满足功能需求，也承接情感需求，但将用户按单一主导需求分类，难以反映两类用途并存的情况。研究基于社会支持理论，利用1090名参与者的数据开发人工智能支持量表，覆盖情绪与自尊、社交陪伴、信息及工具性支持四个维度。结果表明，用户可能同时具有较高的功能性与情感性使用水平，并提供了现实社会支持和幸福感的探索性描述。研究为刻画差异化使用模式提供测量工具，提示系统设计不应假设所有用户均能获得相同收益。
papers.abstract_en: Conversational AI systems are increasingly used to fulfill both functional and affective needs, yet how users perceive the AI-adoption effects varies. Existing research tends to treat these two needs as binary categories and to classify users by a single dominant need. However, this approach fails to capture users who engage with AI for both affective and functional purposes simultaneously, leaving it unclear how these needs combine in real-world AI use. To capture the multifaceted nature of users' AI engagement, we developed the AI-Support measurement with 1,090 participants, grounded in social support theory, which evaluates four dimensions of perceived AI support: emotional/esteem, social companionship, informational, and instrumental support. This study provided (1) an AI-Support Scale developed to measure the perceived support types from human-AI interaction, (2) evidence that users might adopt AI with a high level of both functional and affective use, and (3) exploratory indicators of users' real-life social support and well-being, enabling descriptive results aligning with theoretical expectations. Overall, this study highlights the importance of understanding individual differences in AI affordance use, enabling AI systems to be designed in alignment with different user adoption profiles rather than assuming uniform benefits across all users.

papers.title_en: FATE-5: Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for Continuous Big Five Personality Control
papers.authors: Gunhee Cho, Hongyeob Kim, Yun-Gyung Cheong
papers.evidence: 按用户与交互情境定制对话智能体人格
papers.tldr: 大语言模型的人格控制常面临特质表达强度与对话自然度难以兼顾的问题。FATE-5采用两阶段框架，先通过对话监督和辅助问卷目标学习大五人格的连续软提示表示，再结合对话质量与人格一致性进行偏好对齐。在三个语言模型骨干上，该方法保持较强特质表达，并比其他强特质方法生成更自然的对话；未见问卷上的单调性相关系数达0.97—0.99。这表明，将人格编码与自然度对齐分离，有助于实现连续、可定制且自然的人格控制。
papers.abstract_en: Controlling personality in large language models is important for building conversational agents that can be customized to different users and interaction settings. However, existing personality control methods often face a tradeoff between strong trait expression and natural dialogue generation. We introduce FATE-5, Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for the Big Five, a two-stage framework that separates personality encoding from naturalness alignment. FATE-5 first learns continuous soft prompt representations of Big Five profiles using dialogue supervision and an auxiliary survey objective. It then improves dialogue naturalness through preference alignment based on both dialogue quality and personality agreement. Across three language model backbones, FATE-5 maintains strong trait expression while achieving substantially higher dialogue naturalness than other trait-strong methods. On held-out questionnaires, it achieves monotonicity correlations of 0.97-0.99 and recovery RMSE of 8.9-12.4, substantially improving over the evaluated baselines. These results demonstrate effective continuous personality control while maintaining natural conversational behavior.

papers.title_en: Intent-Preserving Adversarial User Simulation for Multi-Turn Agent Evaluation
papers.authors: Atri Vivek Sharma, Brian Formento, Alessio Lomuscio
papers.evidence: 通过模拟用户和任务完成信号对多轮智能体进行压力测试
papers.tldr: 多轮智能体评测中的模拟用户往往过度配合，导致性能被高估。StressSim在保持用户原始目标的前提下，通过遗传式提示优化搜索更具挑战性的对话计划，无需微调模型。在MultiWOZ及τ-bench零售、航空领域测试中，每任务仅用20次交互轨迹，便使部分模型的连续四次成功指标最高下降69%，目标保持表现降幅不超过10%。该方法揭示了标准及手工设计模拟器遗漏的鲁棒性缺口。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn agents are commonly evaluated with LLM-based simulated users, which can be overly cooperative and can therefore overestimate an agent's performance. We here introduce StressSim, an intent-preserving adversarial user simulator framework for stress-testing agents with challenging yet valid user interactions. StressSim optimises the simulator's high-level adversarial plan for each task instance. Candidate planner prompts are evolved with a genetic prompt-optimisation loop that uses rollout traces, granular task-completion signals, and validity feedback to favour conversations that reduce task success without changing the user's underlying goal. We evaluate the approach on the MultiWOZ dataset and the retail and airline domains from tau-bench with three target LLM agents, comparing against standard simulators and hand-designed non-collaborative user behaviours. We demonstrate the effectiveness of StressSim in exposing robustness gaps across frontier LLMs, with tau-bench pass^4 scores decreasing by up to 69% on gemini-3.8-flash and 62% on gpt-5.6-sol. StressSim maintains goal preservation performance (which decreases by at most 10%), using an optimisation budget of 20 rollouts per task. Sensitivity analysis suggests that increasing the budget further decreases task success. Overall our results demonstrate that StressSim exposes robustness gaps missed by standard and hand-designed user simulators while maintaining conversation realism. This is achieved through lightweight prompt optimisation alone, without model fine-tuning.

papers.title_en: Tactile-Based Robotic Manipulation: From Mechanics-Driven to Data-Driven Perspectives
papers.authors: Jingyi Xiang, Yixuan Wang, Wenzhen Yuan
papers.evidence: 综述机器人操作中的触觉接触感知方法
papers.tldr: 触觉可直接感知接触界面的物理交互，是机器人实现稳健、灵巧操作的重要基础，但如何将触觉信号转化为有效动作仍是核心问题。本文从力学驱动与数据驱动两条互补路线，梳理触觉操作研究的发展。前者利用接触力学和任务知识构建状态并指导动作，后者通过模仿学习、强化学习、视觉语言动作模型及预测模型学习表征与策略。综述整合了两类路线的研究脉络，并提出迈向可扩展、可泛化和稳健触觉机器人系统的开放问题。
papers.abstract_en: Tactile sensing provides robots with direct access to physical interactions at the contact interface, making it a critical modality for robust and dexterous manipulation. Over the past several decades, tactile-based manipulation research has evolved from mechanics-driven approaches, which explicitly interpret tactile signals through contact mechanics and task-specific reasoning, to data-driven approaches that learn tactile representations and manipulation policies directly from data. This paper reviews the development of tactile-based manipulation from these two complementary perspectives. We first introduce the fundamentals of tactile sensing, and then review, from a mechanics-driven perspective, how those signals form manipulation-relevant state representations and subsequently influence the robot action. We then examine the recent advances in data-driven tactile manipulation, covering imitation learning, reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models, and predictive models. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future opportunities toward scalable, generalizable, and robust tactile-enabled robotic systems.

papers.title_en: Beyond Final Outcomes: Quantifying Claim-Level Information Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Interaction
papers.authors: Haocheng Jiang, Herun Wan, Yongyuan Peng, Minnan Luo
papers.evidence: 提出量化大语言模型智能体交互中信息变化的评估框架
papers.tldr: 多智能体评估通常只关注最终任务表现，难以揭示交互中信息如何共享、扩展与遗忘。论文提出RIVER，将智能体输出拆解为原子主张，从收敛、探索和保留三个维度追踪信息动态。在40个受控新闻生成案例中比较五种交互策略发现，反复汇聚信息促进收敛但压缩信息空间，分布式接力则产生更广泛、共享程度更低的信息。这表明，仅看最终结果不足以理解群体交互，底层信息流机制更能解释其信息演化。
papers.abstract_en: When LLM-powered agents interact, information is repeatedly shared, expanded, and forgotten, yet multi-agent evaluation typically focuses on final task outcomes. We study such interaction as claim-level information dynamics and propose RIVER, which decomposes agent outputs into atomic claims and evaluates three complementary dimensions: convergence, exploration, and retention. Convergence captures cross-agent claim correspondence and stance alignment; exploration captures semantic breadth and extension beyond the source; and retention tracks source preservation and the persistence of new claims across stages and lineages. We evaluate five interaction strategies on 40 controlled news-generation cases. Repeatedly pooled interaction promotes convergence but narrows the information space, whereas distributed relay yields broader, less shared information. Further comparisons show that method-specific constraints increase exploration while weakening convergence and retention. Our findings suggest that collective information dynamics are better explained by underlying information-flow mechanisms than by simple downstream performance.

papers.title_en: AI-Augmented Research: Free to Write, Costly to Read
papers.authors: Wolfgang Kuhle
papers.evidence: 分析人工智能如何改变研究生产、核验与文献总结
papers.tldr: 人工智能降低研究写作成本，却未同步降低阅读与核验成本，使有限注意力面临论文洪流。论文构建作者声誉异质、读者在忽略、核验与直接信任之间选择的理论模型，并分析人工智能文献摘要的可靠性。结果表明，写作越便宜，核验范围越窄：低声誉作者被忽略，高声誉作者免于核查；写作成本趋零时，论文影响仅取决于声誉。摘要只有在错误足够独立时才能可靠汇总；同源人工智能写作超过阈值后，共同错误会被固化，人工智能审稿还会排除纠错研究。
papers.abstract_en: We study a model in which artificial intelligence lowers the cost of writing faster than the cost of reading. Authors differ in reputation, and time-constrained readers, such as referees, choose between ignoring, verifying, and trusting papers. As writing costs fall, the band of verified papers shrinks: outsiders are no longer read, and established authors are no longer checked. In the ``costless writing limit,'' the share of verified papers vanishes, and a paper's impact depends on its author's reputation alone. Readers can escape the flood by asking AI to summarize the literature. These summaries aggregate papers reliably only if their errors are sufficiently independent. Once the share of papers written with the same AI exceeds a threshold, summaries inherit the AI's errors, and AI review filters out the original research that could correct them.

papers.title_en: CASE: Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution for Frozen Multimodal Emotion Models
papers.authors: Siyu Wu, Zeyu Liang, Linghao Wang, Qiyun Zheng, Yi Yao, Ling Lo, Hongxia Xie
papers.evidence: 针对相近情绪混淆改进多模态情绪识别
papers.tldr: 多模态大模型虽能理解情绪线索，却常混淆语义相近的情绪，全局参数适配又使纠错成本高、灵活性低。CASE将易混淆情绪对的判别知识外置为稀疏、可演化的技能库，推理时动态检索对应技能，保持骨干模型冻结。在CA-MER上，Qwen3-VL-8B平均准确率由46.80%升至59.13%，并在多个数据集和模型上获得增益。该方法为细粒度情绪识别提供了可复用、可迁移的局部纠错路径。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) by enabling fine-grained emotion understanding through reasoning over multimodal evidence. However, they still exhibit systematic confusion between semantically adjacent emotions with highly overlapping multimodal cues. Existing approaches typically address these errors through global parameter adaptation, making confusion correction costly and inflexible. We instead observe that emotion confusion is highly localized and therefore better addressed through reusable pair-specific expertise. Building on this insight, we propose Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution (CASE), the first agent-skill framework for MER. CASE maintains a sparse, self-evolving library of pair-specific EmotionSkills that externalize affective expertise from model parameters, enabling the learned expertise to be continuously refined and readily transferred across diverse frozen MLLM backbones. During inference, CASE dynamically retrieves the appropriate EmotionSkill to reinforce boundary-aware reasoning while keeping the MLLM backbone frozen. Extensive experiments on CA-MER, DFEW, and EMER demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of CASE across both general-purpose and emotion-specialized MLLMs. Notably, CASE improves the average accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B on the CA-MER benchmark from 46.80% to 59.13%, while achieving consistent gains across MLLMs.

papers.title_en: Ampe-DB: A Dataset for Human Activity and Interaction Analysis Using the Ghanaian Game Ampe
papers.authors: Ruth Senior Biney, Isaac Kojo Yedonu Aboah
papers.evidence: 以多模态数据分析人体动作与双人互动
papers.tldr: 现有动作识别基准缺少文化情境中的双人互动，固定划分高分也可能掩盖跨人泛化失败。论文围绕加纳传统游戏Ampe构建含15名参与者、637段视频的多模态数据集，以视频、姿态及其融合评估动作与动作关系识别。四类识别中，视频模型宏F1从固定基准的0.955降至跨组合的0.418，姿态模型则保持0.811。该数据集拓展了文化活动覆盖，并揭示按参与者及搭档组合评估泛化的重要性。
papers.abstract_en: Human activity recognition benchmarks underrepresent culturally situated forms of movement and interaction. We introduce Ampe-DB, a multimodal dataset based on Ampe, a traditional Ghanaian game involving coordinated jumping, leg movements, and two-person interaction. It contains 637 canonical clips from 15 participants, with RGB video, two-person pose representations, participant and pair metadata, four-class movement labels, and derived binary movement-relation labels.   We evaluate four-class movement recognition and binary movement-relation classification using three protocols: a duplicate-safe fixed benchmark, four-fold pair-held-out evaluation, and participant-held-out diagnostics for participants with complete class coverage. Baselines comprise a frozen Kinetics-400-pretrained R(2+1)D-18 RGB encoder, a two-layer bidirectional GRU for pose sequences, and validation-selected RGB-pose late fusion.   For four-class recognition, RGB macro-F1 falls from 0.955 on the fixed benchmark to 0.418 under pair-held-out evaluation and 0.384 under participant-held-out evaluation. Pose is more robust, achieving 0.957, 0.811, and 0.839 across the same protocols. Fusion reaches 0.976 on the fixed benchmark and 0.824 under pair-held-out evaluation, but does not consistently improve on pose under participant shift. Binary movement-relation recognition also becomes substantially harder under held-out evaluation, especially for different-leg configurations.   These findings show that strong fixed-benchmark scores can mask failures to generalize across people and pairings. Ampe-DB supports research on fine-grained movement recognition, human-human interaction, multimodal learning, and identity-aware generalization.

papers.title_en: Competitive exploration in structured environments
papers.authors: James P. Wolfe, Joshua B. Plotkin
papers.evidence: 建模共享奖励的竞争学习者之间的策略探索
papers.tldr: 竞争如何改变探索未知资源与利用已知资源的权衡？研究将两名ε贪婪时序差分学习者置于一维格点，让其从已知低奖励处寻找远端高奖励，并分析探索率博弈。均衡可表现为双方探索、双方停留或一探一留；局部最佳响应却常使双方陷入集体收益较低的对称行为。告知对方已发现远端奖励的简单信号，可消除许多双方探索型困境，甚至使均衡总收益超过所有无信号结果，揭示信息交流改善竞争性探索效率的作用。
papers.abstract_en: Organisms must constantly weigh exploiting the resources they know against exploring for better ones. When foragers compete, the best behavior for each forager also depends on what its competitors do. How does competition change the strategic balance between exploration and exploitation? Here we address this question in a minimal model: two $ε$-greedy temporal-difference learners on a one-dimensional lattice, who start at a small reward at one end and are unaware of a larger reward at the other. For a lone forager, the optimal exploration rate increases monotonically with the value of the distant reward, and with its distance up to a critical distance. When two foragers share the lattice and split rewards, the choice of exploration rate becomes a game whose Nash equilibria have both foragers exploring, both staying, or one exploring while the other stays (anti-coordination). Under local best-response dynamics, pairs of foragers often converge on both exploring or both staying, even when anti-coordination would be socially optimal. This social dilemma arises for a wide range of parameters, and it persists even in a simplified model without explicit spatial structure. A minimal, naturalistic signal, in which one forager informs the other that it has found the distant reward, can remove many of the dilemmas in which both foragers explore, and can produce a Nash equilibrium whose collective payoff exceeds that of every outcome available without signaling.
